checkpoints.gate: No metal is cut before this sign-off.

items.text: Every box of Prototype and Detail Design is filled in
The four parts are assembled in CAD and meet where the interfaces said
Every drawing has the dimensions and the process to make the part
The numbers show the launcher reaches the speed its target distance needs

criteria.text: Prototype: one question answered with a measured number

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: One question, what was built, a measured result with a number and unit, and the decision it changes.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One thing missing from the Complete line.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A result with no number, no decision, or a rig that tried to answer several questions.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing handed in.

criteria.text: Numbers and parts: the part's key numbers with units and every part from shop stock

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The part's key numbers with units, each from the calculator, a measurement or a spec, and every part listed with size and quantity from shop stock.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One thing missing from the Complete line.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Numbers with no units or no source, or the parts list is missing pieces.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing handed in.

criteria.text: CAD: the part modeled at its real sizes

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every piece of the part modeled at its real sizes, including the holes and faces where it meets the other parts.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One thing missing from the Complete line.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Pieces missing, or sizes clearly off from the numbers.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing handed in.

criteria.text: Drawing and machine plan: someone else could make the part

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Views with every dimension needed to make it, stock and process named, and a machine plan line: which machine, who, which day.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One thing missing from the Complete line.

levels.descriptor: Dimensions missing, or no machine plan.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing handed in.
